unresolved: CategoryEntity is published nowhere, which is a deviation from task 4.1 and the right one: the service has no CategoryController at all, so a category document would advertise a filterable surface for a resource no client can filter. If a category search endpoint is ever added, publishing it is one annotation member.

There is no index endpoint - no way to ask 'what entities publish?'. Deliberate for now: a list of every published name is the one response that helps an enumerator more than a client, and a client that does not know the name of the resource it is querying is unusual. FilterMetadataRegistry.publishedNames() exists for one if it is ever wanted.

The document is computed per request with no cache, by design D3. If a deployment ever measures this as hot, the fix goes through LudwigCacheRegistry with CachePurpose.SECURITY and a key that includes the caller's resolved role set - never a Caffeine builder, and never keyed on the entity alone, which would serve an administrator's field list to an unprivileged caller.
